title: MRR ModelProfile
description: docs/spec/01_SYSTEM_SPEC.md MRR-FR-045 ('Model invocations MUST use a provider-neutral adapter and record model profile ...') and MRR-NFR-004/MRR-NFR-010 (vendor neutrality, framework-/provider-free core). First task of Epic E4 (task-packets/E4-T01.yaml); the twelfth entity schema in this repository. A ModelProfile is a canonically hashable, provider-opaque description of one model configuration — 'provider' is a plain opaque string label with no enumerated vendor vocabulary, never a vendor type, checked structurally (not by convention) by this repository's import-linter contracts. 'decoding_parameters' is a fully open object (like task-bundle.schema.json's own 'instructions' field) rather than a closed, provider-specific schema, since providers name sampling knobs differently — 'temperature' is the one key this schema gives conventional meaning to (near-universal across providers), checked by the if/then below against 'determinism' (MRR-FR-044: an explicit, REQUIRED, never-silently-defaulted deterministic/stochastic distinction; a profile declaring determinism='deterministic' while also declaring a nonzero sampling temperature is rejected, both here and by packages/contracts/mrr/contracts/model_profile.py's own model_validator — mirroring verification-result.schema.json's own 'enforced twice' precedent). 'config_hash' is a second, narrower canonical hash than the inherited baseObject 'content_hash' — computed over exactly this schema's eight own properties (provider through tool_permissions), so two independently created profiles sharing the same configuration are recognizable by comparing this one field alone, reusing mrr.domain.hashing_policy (RFC 8785 + SHA-256), never a new hash. 'model_family' and 'prompt_family' are the two MRR-FR-071 independence dimensions this profile CARRIES for E4-T05 to consume later — this schema does not itself compute independence.

provider.description: Opaque provider label (e.g. 'anthropic', 'openai', 'local-ollama') — never a vendor type or enumerated vocabulary (MRR-NFR-004).

model_family.description: MRR-FR-071 independence dimension 'model_family', carried here for E4-T05 to consume — this schema does not compute independence.

model_identifier.description: The full model identifier/version string (e.g. a dated model snapshot name).

decoding_parameters.description: Provider-neutral, open decoding/sampling configuration (e.g. temperature, top_p, max_output_tokens) — no closed vocabulary, since providers name these differently. 'temperature', if present, is checked against 'determinism' by the if/then below.

determinism.description: MRR-FR-044: whether this profile's configuration is deterministic or stochastic. Explicit and required — never inferred or silently defaulted.

prompt_family.description: MRR-FR-071 independence dimension 'prompt_family', carried here for E4-T05 to consume — this schema does not compute independence.

tool_permissions.description: Tool names this profile is permitted to invoke; an empty array means none declared.

config_hash.description: Canonical hash of exactly this schema's own eight properties (provider through tool_permissions) — narrower than, and independent of, the inherited baseObject content_hash.
